component.name: epubkit
component.summary: Optimize EPUB books for e-ink readers

description.p: epubkit gets any EPUB ready for a small e-ink reader in one pass. It is tuned for the Xteink X4 and X3, and the books it makes read well on any EPUB reader.

ul.li: Converts images to baseline JPEG, sized for the screen and dithered to four shades of grey
Removes embedded fonts and stylesheet rules the book never uses
Repairs broken markup and text read in the wrong encoding
Fixes the table of contents and strips store metadata
Rotates and splits double-page spreads for manga and light novels

description.p: Books protected by DRM are recognised and left alone. epubkit is based on the original by b1rdmania.
The first release packaged as a Flatpak.
